data.title: 摩根 · 圣枪誓约
data.description: 【摩根 · 圣枪誓约】冬宫的高台上，摩根单手拄着圣枪伦戈米尼亚德，长裙被晚风拂动，冰蓝瞳仁映着天边的最后一缕光——「圣枪之下，我将以这片土地为誓，守护到底。」
data.action: 站在冬宫高台上，一手稳住竖立的圣枪，另一手垂在裙侧，望向余晖
data.camera: full-body shot, upright lance and palace platform visible
data.promptProse: Morgan steadies the upright Rhongomyniad with one hand, her other hand resting beside her skirt as she looks beyond the battlements. The last golden light catches the lance and her windblown hem.
